playstyle: Plant the shield between the party and the hit, let the share meter climb while the ally's bar stays flat, then spend 100 meter points on Bulwark Charge and a slam.

abilities.name: Bulwark Stance
effects: share meter fills x1.5 while active
abilities.notes: The cheap anchor. It buys the redirect time and tells the ally the tank is taking the hits now.

abilities.name: Shield Ram
abilities.notes: Bottom of the strike line. Low damage, low cooldown, and the slow is the real value.

abilities.name: Weight of the Line
effects: aura on the caster, radius 8 m, 8 s
allies in the aura take 40% less damage for 8 s
60% of the damage they avoid is redirected to the caster
share meter decay pauses while the aura is up
abilities.notes: The 2026 fix in one ability: the share meter is visible under the health bar and climbs while the ally's bar stays flat, so the redirect reads as value. Global share rules: 0 to 100 points, decays 3 points per second while no share aura is up, and every 25 points gives the caster -2% damage taken (max -8%).

abilities.name: Cradle Sweep
effects: hits every target in the cone
abilities.notes: First cone of the strike line. Two shields wide, so it catches a front pair, and the slow outlasts the swing.

abilities.name: Oath of the Line
effects: aura on the caster, radius 10 m, 10 s
allies in the aura take 50% less damage for 10 s
70% of the damage they avoid is redirected to the caster
share meter decay pauses while the aura is up
only one share aura can be up at a time; this replaces Weight of the Line
abilities.notes: The bigger share. Wider, deeper and faster filling than tier 0: 50% reduction and one point per two damage redirected.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.notes: The strike line goes area. The circle decal is on the floor for 0.8 s, so the enemy chooses to stand in it.

abilities.name: Bulwark Charge
effects: not castable while the share meter is below 100 points; the button shows the meter as its cost
consumes 100 share meter points on cast
allies within 6 m gain +20% damage dealt for 6 s
abilities.notes: The meter payoff. This is why the redirect is worth taking hits for: 100 points buy a hit that hands the party 20% more damage.

abilities.name: Iron Tide
abilities.notes: The room-clearing tier 3. Five metres of floor, and the knockback is what stops the second wave.

abilities.name: Second Stand
abilities.notes: The damage block carries the heal amount, on the CON scale: 130 x (1 + 0.04 x (CON - 10)). It also puts 60 meter points back, so a bad redirect is a delayed Bulwark Charge, not a lost one.

abilities.name: Hold Fast
abilities.notes: Top of the strike line: 132 base, six metres of floor, and the tank is safer while it lands. One minute of cooldown, so it is a fight changer, not a rotation.

abilities.name: Aegis Rite
effects: aura on the caster, radius 12 m, 12 s
allies in the aura take 65% less damage for 12 s
80% of the damage they avoid is redirected to the caster
share meter cap rises from 100 to 150 points
allies in the aura gain +15% damage dealt for 12 s
abilities.notes: Top of the share line: 65% reduction, 12 m, one point per damage redirected and a 150 point cap. With this up a Bulwark Charge can be paid for twice.

weakness: Ranged and long-range casters ignore the aura: ashkin_gunner, ashkin_rune and warden_sorcerer all kill from outside the share aura, 12 m at its best, and warden_cleric plus ashkin_life out-heal anything the tank takes for itself.
